name: B10-0438/2025 (The Left) – Arbitrary detention of EU citizens Javier Marañón Montero and David Rodríguez Ballesta in Equatorial Guinea
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arbitrary detention of EU citizens Javier Marañón Montero and David Rodríguez Ballesta in Equatorial Guinea
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling on Equatorial Guinea to release two Spanish citizens, Javier Marañón Montero and David Rodríguez Ballesta, held without trial since January 2025. It says they are in a prison known for inhumane conditions, cut off from family and lawyers, and that one is on hunger strike with critical health. The Parliament asks for fair, timely trials, proper prison conditions and medical care. This is an opinion; the Parliament cannot order their release.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament only asks Equatorial Guinea to act.
- **Who it affects:** The two detained Spanish citizens and their families.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to European Union bodies, member states and Equatorial Guinea's authorities.
